continuity_scope: Terms-only audit bound to Planescape: Adventures in the Multiverse, the official 2023 fifth-edition tabletop boxed set and its three constituent books: Sigil and the Outlands, Morte’s Planar Parade, and Turn of Fortune’s Wheel. Second-edition Planescape material, Planescape: Torment (separately catalogued as SRC-141), other video games, novels, adaptations, home campaigns, and later or earlier products are excluded and not merged.

coverage_rule: No characters are included. The accessible official witnesses describe the boxed set’s setting structure, books, and categories, but do not supply stable claim-level profiles for named dramatic individuals. Named figures mentioned only as a guide, setting ruler, example, or adventure material are therefore omitted. Planes, places, portals, factions, ancestries, monsters, items, and rules remain terms/context rather than character endpoints.
omissions: All named individuals, including Morte, the Lady of Pain, and any Turn of Fortune’s Wheel NPCs, because the selected accessible official witnesses do not provide claim-level individual profiles.
All second-edition Planescape claims, terminology meanings, and continuity assertions unless separately evidenced in this exact 2023 fifth-edition product.
Planescape: Torment characters, events, game-specific mechanics, and adaptation claims; that computer-game continuity is separately scoped as SRC-141.
All unverified errata, live-page revisions, and cross-product retcon reconciliation.
uncertainties: This is a fifth-edition setting product, not a D&D core-rule source or a universal statement of multiverse canon.

The official overview announced an October 17, 2023 release, while the D&D Beyond source record and release/support material are dated October 2–3, 2023; these records are retained as product-publication evidence rather than normalized into a single publication-date assertion.
No distinct official errata document for this product was accessed in this audit. The cited D&D Beyond materials may be updated over time, so no exhaustive product-update claim is made.
The audit does not resolve second-edition-to-fifth-edition terminology changes or retcons; the 2023 boxed set has priority only inside this source record.
evidence_basis: Official D&D Beyond product and release materials identify the 2023 boxed set as a planar adventure setting spanning infinite realities, enumerate its three books, and name Sigil, the Outlands, the Outer Planes, gate-towns, and factions as setting structure. They do not offer adequate individual character profiles, so a terms-only setting audit is warranted.
